approvedInputs.goal: I want to learn why the old observatory's star charts show a constellation my grandmother taught me to recognize.
boundaries: Do not reveal that the grandmother is secretly alive.
Do not decide what Tamsin believes or does.

quests.title: Restore the observatory lens
quests.summary: The party has agreed to recover the lens from a sealed room in the old observatory so the town archivist can resume mapping the night sky.

hooks.proposal: If the party chooses to inspect the observatory's chart table while retrieving the lens, a copied chart could show the same constellation in a different position. This is a proposed clue, not established lore.
hooks.playerChoice: Tamsin may compare the chart with what she learned, ask the archivist to preserve it, or leave it for later.
hooks.possiblePayoff: If Tamsin wants to investigate, the archivist could help compare the copied chart with publicly available observations; no explanation is assumed.
hooks.longTermArc: With the player's continued interest, later approved quests could offer more chart comparisons without defining the grandmother's status or Tamsin's conclusions.
hooks.spotlight: Offer the comparison as an optional pause that another character can help with; continue the lens quest if Tamsin passes.

hooks.proposal: The town archivist could ask whether Tamsin wants to help test the restored lens against the chart. The invitation does not assume she accepts or that the test proves anything.
hooks.playerChoice: Tamsin can suggest a different test, invite a companion to participate, decline, or return to the group's other priorities.
hooks.possiblePayoff: If the group elects to test it, they might gain a better-recorded observation to compare later, not a guaranteed answer or reward.
hooks.longTermArc: If the player chooses to pursue it, the chart comparison can remain an open question revisited when another approved quest naturally involves the night sky.
hooks.spotlight: Keep the test brief and collaborative; let the party complete the lens objective without requiring a personal scene.

spotlightBalance: Only one character goal was supplied, so this draft cannot compare attention across the party. Both hooks are optional, shareable, and skippable; use at most one unless Tamsin's player shows continued interest.
unknowns: The chart's meaning, history, and whether it is accurate are unknown.
Tamsin's interpretation and response are for the player to decide.
reviewNotes: Fictional sample only; not campaign canon.
All hooks, payoffs, and longer arcs are proposals contingent on player choice and DM approval.
Do not disclose this DM-only draft to players; any transfer requires separate manual review.
